games.name: [🖼️ MUSEUM] Chameleon
games.desc:
🎨 CHAMELEON

Blend in. Paint yourself. Trick the seekers.

Chameleon is a hide and seek painting game inspired by Meccha Chameleon, where hiders use colors, brushes, and smart camouflage to survive while seekers hunt them down with abilities.

Paint your character to match the map, hide in plain sight, use taunts, freeze in place, and outplay the seekers before time runs out.

Join our group for updates, rewards, codes, testing access, and future content drops.

Controls:
B Brush
G Fill
C Color Picker
Q Undo
E Redo
F Freeze
T Taunt
R Abilities

Keywords:

games.name: SCORCHED EARTH 🔊
games.desc:
Hardcore Sandbox FPS, featuring advanced destruction, building, and volumetric smoke grenades.

Roblox Premium gives you 15% extra match bonus.

Private servers have everything unlocked & server tools, but stats dont transfer to the main game.

C / X: lower/raise stance
Q & E: lean
M: open squad menu
TAB: scoreboard
B: cycle firemode
V: melee (only for some tools and bayonets)
AIM + SHIFT: steady aim
AIM + SCROLL: zeroing (only on some weapons)
AIM + ALT: switch to irons
T: Squad orders/ping
CTRL / Tilde (~): aim (for laptop users)
C + SCROLL: incremental stances

Beta released on July 12th 2024.

games.name: SPECTER
games.desc:
Investigate ghosts in haunted locations with your friends. Use your equipment to find paranormal evidence and work out the ghost type, then escape before the ghost hunts you!

Use hiding spots to your advantage, and carefully control your stamina to survive the hunt. If you need more help, read the journal's FAQ section during a match, or check out our server.

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and scary scenes.
⚙️ An extensive settings menu is available in the lobby! Customize your experience to your liking.
🎧 We recommend using headphones for the best experience.
🎙️ Spirit box and the team radio feature support voice chat!
🎵 The lobby music and ambient soundtracks used in SPECTER are original and copyright free, you are free to use them in videos!

Inspired by the horror game Phasmophobia.
